I wrote the review to `.social-review.md`, and all three platforms fail.

- **X:** The copy has bold markdown (`**coding**`). The suggested copy drops the markers.
- **LinkedIn:** The copy uses the banned phrase "We're excited to announce". The suggested copy drops that opening sentence.
- **Bluesky:** The copy is a single paragraph, but it needs two. The suggested copy splits it after the second sentence.

None of the failures are character-limit failures, so per SKILL.md none of them fails the check on its own. The suggested copy is 250/255 for X, 1188/2950 for LinkedIn and 264/300 for Bluesky. I checked the X and Bluesky counts by running them. I worked out the LinkedIn count by subtracting the removed sentence from the original 1227.

I did not run the critique sub-agent loop or the suggestions pass. I judged the copy directly against the critique rubric's hard-fail rules. There is no advisory section, since every platform failed and was repaired. I did not post a PR comment.
